name: Doubler
summary: A Martingale-based Expert Advisor that doubles the lot size after each losing trade, aiming to recover previous losses with a single win. It enters positions based on simple directional signals and relies on the Martingale progression to eventually achieve net profit when a winning trade occurs.
summary_zh: 基于马丁格尔策略的EA，每次亏损后将交易手数翻倍，试图通过一次盈利覆盖之前所有亏损。该EA使用简单的方向信号入场，依赖马丁格尔倍投机制在赢取交易时实现净盈利。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用经典马丁格尔策略，核心概念是在每次亏损后将下一笔交易的手数翻倍，理论上只要最终有一笔盈利交易，就能覆盖之前所有累计亏损并实现净收益。入场条件通常基于简单的趋势或动量信号，如移动平均线交叉或RSI超买超卖反转，部分实现可能仅使用固定方向或随机入场。出场条件为达到固定止盈目标时平仓，止损设置可选但许多马丁格尔EA不设止损，依赖倍投而非止损来控制风险。仓位管理采用几何级数递增模式（1、2、4、8、16...），初始手数较小但随着连亏次数增加，手数呈指数级增长。资金管理方面缺乏有效的最大回撤保护或连亏次数限制，在长期连亏场景下账户极易爆仓，属于高风险策略类型。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs the classic Martingale strategy, whose core concept is to double the lot size after each losing trade, so that theoretically a single winning trade can recover all cumulative losses and achieve net profit. Entry conditions are typically based on simple trend or momentum signals such as moving average crossovers or RSI overbought/oversold reversals, though some implementations may use fixed direction or even random entry. Exit conditions involve closing positions upon reaching a fixed take-profit target, while stop-loss settings are optional and many Martingale EAs omit stop-loss entirely, relying on position doubling rather than stops for risk control. Position sizing follows a geometric progression pattern (1, 2, 4, 8, 16...), starting with a small initial lot but scaling exponentially with each consecutive loss. Money management lacks effective maximum drawdown protection or consecutive loss limits, making the account extremely vulnerable to margin calls during extended losing streaks, categorizing this as a high-risk strategy type.

parameters.description_en: Initial lot size, opening volume of first trade

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示不设止损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 means no stop loss

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于标识本EA的订单

pros: 策略逻辑简单直观，易于理解和调试
在短期震荡行情或有限连亏次数内，能快速回收亏损并实现盈利
代码结构通常较为简洁，适合作为马丁格尔策略的学习模板
盈利时净收益为初始手数对应的利润，在大多数单次循环中表现稳定
pros_en: Strategy logic is simple and intuitive, easy to understand and debug
In short-term ranging markets or with limited consecutive losses, it can quickly recover losses and achieve profit
Code structure is typically concise, suitable as a learning template for Martingale strategies
Net profit per winning cycle equals the initial lot's profit, showing stable performance in most single cycles
cons: 手数呈指数级增长，连续亏损后极易触及保证金限制导致爆仓
缺乏有效的最大回撤保护和连亏次数硬限制
在趋势行情中单方向持续亏损时风险极度放大
不设止损的情况下，单笔亏损可能远超预期
长期数学期望为负，马丁格尔策略本质不可持续
cons_en: Lot size grows exponentially, making margin calls highly likely after consecutive losses
Lacks effective maximum drawdown protection and hard limits on consecutive loss count
Risk amplifies extremely during trending markets with sustained one-direction losses
Without stop-loss, a single losing position can far exceed expectations
Long-term mathematical expectation is negative; Martingale strategy is fundamentally unsustainable
improvements: 增加最大连续亏损次数限制，达到上限后重置手数而非继续倍投
添加账户净值回撤百分比硬限制，超过阈值自动停止交易并平仓
引入趋势过滤器避免在强趋势中逆势加仓
improvements_en: Add a maximum consecutive loss count limit that resets lot size instead of continuing to double
Implement account equity drawdown percentage hard limit that auto-stops trading and closes positions beyond threshold
Introduce a trend filter to avoid adding positions against strong trends

risk_points: 马丁格尔倍投机制导致手数指数级增长，连续亏损后爆仓概率极高
缺少止损设置或止损为0，单笔亏损无上限
无最大回撤保护和连亏次数限制
保证金不足时无法继续倍投，导致未实现亏损无法回收
risk_points_en: Martingale doubling mechanism causes exponential lot growth with extremely high margin call probability after consecutive losses
Missing stop-loss or stop-loss set to 0 means unlimited single-trade loss exposure
No maximum drawdown protection or consecutive loss count limits
Insufficient margin prevents continued doubling, leaving unrealized losses unrecoverable
